articles.summary: TORM plc (Nasdaq: TRMD or TRMD A (At the Annual General Meeting held on 15 April 2026, the Directors Remuneration Report, the Directors Remuneration Policy (the Remuneration Resolutions) and the off-market share buyback authority (Buyback Contract B) (the Share Buyback resolution) each received more than 20% votes against the Boards recommendation. In accordance with Provision 4 of the UK Corporate Governance Code, the Board has undertaken a programme of shareholder consultation to better understand the reasons for the voting outcomes and to consider any actions that may be appropriate. Engagement undertaken Following the AGM, the Company engaged with shareholders representing a significant proportion of the votes cast against the relevant resolutions. articles.title: TORM plc - Update on Shareholder Engagement Following the 2026 AGM
